title: The New Stone Tablets and the Renewal of the Covenant
description: The Lord commands Moses to carve two new stone tablets and reveals His name as a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love. Moses worships and asks the Lord to go with the people. The Lord renews the covenant, gives instructions to avoid idolatry, tear down altars, observe the festivals, and consecrate the firstborn. Moses stays on the mountain for forty days and forty nights, and the words of the covenant—the Ten Words—are written on the tablets.
